title: Fail closed on unresolved command-journal authority
summary: Preserve malformed authoritative command history, expose degraded load evidence, and reject strict mutations until a valid restart recovery.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W01-003. CommandJournal currently converts JSON read/decode failures into a healthy empty history, then lets the next command overwrite the unreadable authority.
